messages.author: 77d64ceb1fdc328c
messages.subject: Error in plot Phylomorphospace
parts:
Good morning,
I'd like to plot my Phylomorphospace PCA and get this error message:
Some of the arguments in phylo.pars are different than those that are possible (see Arguments).
To make sure that I got my R grammar right I ran the example in the help file:
data(plethspecies)
Y.gpa <- gpagen(plethspecies$land) #GPA-alignment
gp.end <- factor(c(0,0,1,0,0,1,1,0,0)) #endangered species vs. rest
names(gp.end) <- plethspecies$phy$tip
gdf <- geomorph.data.frame(Y.gpa, phy = plethspecies$phy,
                           gp.end = gp.end)
pleth.ols <- procD.lm(coords ~ Csize + gp.end,
                      data = gdf) # ordinary least squares
summary(pleth.ols)

PCA <- gm.prcomp(Y.gpa$coords, phy = plethspecies$phy)

# Phylomorphospace
PC.plot <- plot(PCA, pch = 19, phylo = TRUE, main = "PCA-OLS")

... and get the same error.
So, I guess that there is an issue with the plot function, right?

Many thanks,
Nadja

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Error in plot Phylomorphospace
parts:
Dear Nadja,

It is helpful when you report errors that you also report the version of geomorph (or any other package) that you are using.  I suspect you are using version 4.0.7.  I verified that your code works with version 4.0.7.999, which can be installed via github,

devtools::install_github("geomorphR/geomorph", ref = “Stable", build_vignettes = TRUE)

Note that concomitant update of RRPP is also advised:

devtools::install_github(“mlcollyer/RRPP", build_vignettes = TRUE)

This is an issue that was already fixed on the Github version of the package.  The issue resulted from forced function and object name changes imposed when R was updated to version 4.3.  We will have to make an update to submit to CRAN soon, but as R is now updated to version 4.4, a geomorph update will involve more than simple patches.

Hope this helps!
Mike
